subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the stair enclosure are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? We would like this closed out ahead of the next submittal deadline. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected. A response within three days would be appreciated. It is not clear whether this reflects a real design decision that needs interpreting, or just a documentation error that should be corrected without changing intent.
